facts.text: 维琳娜汇聚旋风，随后召唤出[广域气旋]，持续攻击敌人，并触发上一位角色的[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: Velina channels a whirlwind and summons a Sweeping Cyclone to continuously attack enemies and triggers the previous character's Quick Assist.

facts.text: 招式发动后将触发上一位角色的[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: After using this skill, the previous character's Quick Assist is triggered.

facts.text:
维琳娜初始能量自动回复大于1.2时，超过部分每超过0.01，造成的伤害提升0.21%，最多提升35%，异常掌控提升0.5点，最多提升84点；
维琳娜进入战场时，获得45点[风华]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次，维琳娜发动[强化特殊技：风切变·扬清]或[强化特殊技：风切变·三重绝息]都会获得45点[风华]，[风华]上限为135点；
维琳娜触发[乱流]时，会获得1点[风蚀]并召唤[微域气旋]，造成风属性伤害，该效果每3秒最多触发一次，当维琳娜拥有2点[风蚀]时，维琳娜下一次触发[乱流]时，会消耗2点[风蚀]使此时[乱流]的伤害倍率提升150%，并且不再召唤[微域气旋]转而召唤[广域气旋]，此时不会获得[风蚀]；
当维琳娜召唤的[广域气旋]首次命中处于[浸染]状态下的敌人，会触发[赋彩]效果，转化为相应属性的[广域气旋]，并会造成相应属性的伤害，[广域气旋]攻击命中敌人时，会使敌人的风属性异常积蓄抗性降低7%，持续35秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，若[赋彩]后的[广域气旋]攻击命中敌人，则敌人的相应属性异常积蓄抗性也会降低7%，持续35秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
受到[广域气旋]影响的敌人被击败时，会使该[广域气旋]的持续时间延长5秒，该效果对同一[广域气旋]仅能触发一次，同一时间只能存在一个[广域气旋]；
[微域气旋]和[广域气旋]会在消散时触发一次爆炸，该次爆炸命中处于风属性异常状态下的敌人时，都会对目标造成一次[异放]伤害：额外结算一次属性异常伤害，固定结算145%和255%倍率的风属性异常伤害。
facts.textEn:
When Velina's initial Energy Regen exceeds 1.2, every additional 0.01 increases DMG dealt by 0.21%, up to a maximum increase of 35%, and increases Anomaly Mastery by 0.5, up to a maximum increase of 84.
When Velina enters the battlefield, she gains 45 Windbloom. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. Using EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise or EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow grants 45 Windbloom, up to a maximum of 135 Windbloom. 
When Velina triggers Vortex, she gains 1 point of Windbite and summons a Condensed Cyclone, dealing Wind DMG. This effect can trigger once every 3s. When Velina has 2 points of Windbite, the next time she triggers Vortex, 2 points of Windbite are consumed to increase that Vortex's DMG Multiplier by 150%. In addition, a Sweeping Cyclone is summoned instead of a Condensed Cyclone, which does not grant Windbite.
When Velina's summoned Sweeping Cyclone hits an enemy suffering Contamination for the first time, it triggers Chromatic Tint, converting it into a Sweeping Cyclone of the corresponding attribute, dealing the corresponding attribute's DMG. When Sweeping Cyclone hits an enemy, the enemy's Wind Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced by 7% for 35s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If a Sweeping Cyclone enhanced by Chromatic Tint hits an enemy, the enemy's corresponding Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES is also reduced by 7% for 35s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by Sweeping Cyclone is defeated, the duration of that Sweeping Cyclone is extended by 5s. This effect can only trigger once for the same Sweeping Cyclone, and only one Sweeping Cyclone can exist at a time.
Condensed Cyclone and Sweeping Cyclone trigger an explosion when they dissipate. If this explosion hits an enemy suffering a Wind Anomaly, it triggers one instance of Abloom DMG against the target: resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG, dealing a fixed 145% and 255% multiplier Wind Anomaly DMG respectively.

cinema.name: 秩序化优雅
cinema.description: [额外能力：茶会礼仪]中，[广域气旋]造成的失衡值额外提升20%；维琳娜触发[乱流]时无视目标20%全属性伤害抗性；全队造成[风化]伤害时，无视目标20%风属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: Sweeping Cyclone from Additional Ability: Tea Party Etiquette deals an additional 20% Daze. When Velina triggers Vortex, she ignores 20% of the target's All-Attribute RES. When squad members deal Windswept DMG, 20% of the target's Wind RES is ignored.

cinema.name: 饱和式计划
cinema.description: 维琳娜触发[风化]时，也可以获取1点[风蚀]，该效果每5秒最多触发一次；[广域气旋]触发[赋彩]效果后，可以积蓄相应属性的异常积蓄值，且该攻击累积的属性异常积蓄值不参与异常伤害结算；[额外能力：茶会礼仪]中，维琳娜造成的[风化]和[乱流]伤害提升效果额外提升15%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Velina triggers Windswept, she can also gain 1 point of Windbite. This effect can trigger once every 5s. After Sweeping Cyclone triggers the Chromatic Tint effect, it can accumulate the corresponding attribute's Anomaly Buildup. The buildup accumulated by this attack is excluded from Anomaly DMG calculations. The DMG increase effects of Velina's Windswept and Vortex from Additional Ability: Tea Party Etiquette are further increased by 15%.

Unleashes a sweeping gust forward, dealing Wind DMG.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：风切变·扬清
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
先向后闪避，随后扇出巨大风弹攻击敌人，造成风属性伤害；
向后闪避期间，具备闪避判定，如果成功闪避敌人攻击，会触发[极限视域]；
发动该招式后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接[普通攻击]第五段；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Dodges backward, then unleashes a massive wind blast to attack enemies, dealing Wind DMG.
During the backward dodge, a dodge effect is active. Successfully dodging an enemy attack triggers Vital View.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to chain into the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：风切变·三重绝息
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow
ex.description:
能量足够时，在[强化特殊技：风切变·扬清]后点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
连续挥舞扇子，对敌人造成风属性伤害；
发动该招式后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可衔接[普通攻击]第五段；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy and after using EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Continuously swings the fan, dealing Wind DMG.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to chain into the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：风切变·风暴眼
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm
ex.description:
[风华]大于等于90点时，长按 【特殊技键】 或 【普通攻击键】 发动：
维琳娜汇聚旋风，随后召唤出[广域气旋]，持续攻击敌人，并触发上一位角色的[快速支援]；
[广域气旋]持续5秒，每0.5秒对周边敌人造成一次风属性伤害。
ex.descriptionEn:
With 90 or more Windbloom, hold [Special Attack] or [Basic Attack] to activate:
Velina channels a whirlwind and summons a Sweeping Cyclone to continuously attack enemies and triggers the previous character's Quick Assist.
Sweeping Cyclone lasts for 5s and deals Wind DMG to nearby enemies once every 0.5s.

ultimate.name: 终结技：聆听呼啸
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方进行多段攻击，造成大量风属性伤害；
招式发动后将触发上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes multiple attacks against enemies ahead, dealing massive Wind DMG.
After using this skill, the previous character's Quick Assist is triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：紧急预案
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成风属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

156100013.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
156100013.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
